zh.title: 印尼喀拉喀托之子火山噴發 8座機場暫停營運
zh.summary: 印尼火山噴發導致八座機場暫停航班營運；雅加達蘇凱諾哈達國際機場（CGK）受影響。
body: 印尼交通部長波瓦甘迪（Dudy Purwagandhi）於2026年9月6日證實，受到喀拉喀托之子火山（Mount Anak Krakatau）噴發及隨之產生的火山灰雲影響，印尼共有八座機場的營運服務已暫時停止，包含首都雅加達的主要國際樞紐蘇凱諾哈達國際機場（CGK）。火山灰噴發導致多個航點的航班陷入停擺，數以千計的旅客行程受到影響。
根據印尼國家通訊社安塔拉（Antara）引述火山暨地質災害減緩中心（PVMBG）資料，本次火山噴發始於2026年9月4日晚間23時07分，並於9月6日凌晨00時04分結束，隨後在9月6日當天又發生了兩次後續噴發。印尼氣象、氣候與地球物理局（BMKG）氣象代理副局長藍達尼（Andri Ramdhani）指出，觀測紀錄顯示火山灰向東擴散高度達20,000英呎，向西擴散高度則高達50,000英呎。

因應火山灰對飛航安全的威脅，印尼導航局（AirNav Indonesia）已發布多份飛航通告（NOTAM），關閉相關機場周邊空域。波瓦甘迪部長列出的八座受影響機場包括：蘇凱諾哈達國際機場（CGK）、Halim Perdanakusuma Airport（HLP）、Radin Inten II Airport（TKG）、Husein Sastranegara Airport（BDO）、Budiarto Curug Airport（RTO）、Pondok Cabe Airport（PCB）、Taufik Kiemas Airport（TFY）以及 Atung Bungsu Airport（PXA）。當天稍早原本僅有六座機場關閉，後因風向改變，致使受影響名單增加兩座機場。
交通部長波瓦甘迪要求各大航空公司，必須就航班時間異動、取消或轉降向旅客提供明確資訊，並確保依據適用法規保障乘客權益。國營航空公司印尼鷹航（Garuda Indonesia）向乘客表示，由於喀拉喀托之子火山灰影響，目前已對多班往返雅加達的航班進行調整。BMKG則表示正針對火山噴發動態及其對大氣、航空和海象的影響進行24小時密切監測。

en.title: Mount Anak Krakatau Eruption Grounds Flights at Eight Indonesian Airports
en.summary: Indonesia grounds flights at eight airports including Jakarta (CGK) following Mount Anak Krakatau volcanic eruption.
body: Indonesian Minister of Transportation Dudy Purwagandhi confirmed on September 6, 2026, that operational services at eight airports have been temporarily suspended following the eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau and the resulting ash cloud. The closures include Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK), Jakarta's primary international gateway. The flight groundings have impacted travel schedules for thousands of passengers across the region.

According to the Center for Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation (PVMBG) cited by Indonesian news agency Antara, the eruption commenced at 23:07 on September 4, 2026, and ended at 00:04 on September 6, 2026, followed by two subsequent eruptions later on September 6. Andri Ramdhani, Acting Deputy for Meteorology at the Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG), stated that ash dust was recorded moving up to an altitude of 20,000 feet to the east and 50,000 feet to the west.

In response to the hazards posed by the volcanic ash, AirNav Indonesia issued several Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) alerts closing the airspace surrounding the impacted airports as a safety precaution. Minister Purwagandhi detailed the eight affected facilities as Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, Halim Perdanakusuma Airport (HLP), Radin Inten II Airport (TKG), Husein Sastranegara Airport (BDO), Budiarto Curug Airport (RTO), Pondok Cabe Airport (PCB), Taufik Kiemas Airport (TFY), and Atung Bungsu Airport (PXA). Earlier in the day, only six airports were shut down, but shifts in wind direction forced authorities to add two additional airports to the closure list.

Minister Purwagandhi instructed operating airlines to provide passengers with transparent information regarding schedule changes, flight cancellations, or diversions, while ensuring that passenger rights are met according to governing regulations. Flag carrier Garuda Indonesia informed travelers that several flights to and from Jakarta are currently being adjusted due to the ash cloud from Mount Anak Krakatau. Meanwhile, BMKG confirmed it is intensifying round-the-clock monitoring of the eruption's development and its operational effects on atmospheric, aviation, and maritime conditions.

zh.title: 蒙特婁機場地勤人員遭空中巴士A350撞擊不治身亡
zh.summary: 蒙特婁機場8月24日發生意外，一名地勤人員遭空中巴士A350客機撞擊不治身亡。
body: 加拿大蒙特婁特魯多國際機場（Montreal-Trudeau International Airport）於2026年8月24日發生一起地面安全意外。根據航空新聞媒體Simple Flying於9月6日發布的報導，一名地面勤務人員在現場作業期間，遭到一架空中巴士A350-900型客機撞擊，隨後不幸傷重不治身亡。
相關消息指出，該名受害地勤人員是在客機進行地面後推作業（pushback）過程中不慎跌倒，隨後遭移動中的客機撞擊。目前報導中並未透露涉事航空公司的具體名稱、航班編號，亦未列出事故發生的確切時間與當地調查機構的最新調查進度。

en.title: Ramp Agent Dies After Being Struck by Airbus A350 at Montreal Airport
en.summary: A ramp agent died after being struck by an Airbus A350 at Montreal Airport on August 24.
body: A ground accident occurred at Montreal Trudeau International Airport on August 24, involving an Airbus A350-900 aircraft and an airport ramp agent. According to a report by Simple Flying, the ramp agent was struck by the aircraft on the airport tarmac and subsequently succumbed to fatal injuries.

The report indicated that the individual reportedly stumbled during a pushback operation immediately before being struck by the Airbus A350-900 aircraft. No additional information was provided in the source report regarding the identity of the airline operator, the flight number, or any official aviation safety investigation status associated with the August 24 occurrence at Montreal Trudeau International Airport.

zh.title: Recaro交付新型R4豪華經濟艙座椅 全日空787-9機隊2026年底導入
zh.summary: Recaro交付R4豪華經濟艙座椅；全日空預計2026年底於787-9啟用
body: 德國座椅製造商Recaro Aircraft Seating已開始交付其新款R4豪華經濟艙座椅。日本全日空（All Nippon Airways）預計將於2026年底前，在其波音（Boeing）787-9長程客機隊上正式導入這款全新座椅產品。
Recaro指出，新型R4座椅的交付工作已於2026年6月展開。作為Recaro熱門PL3530長程豪華經濟艙座椅的後續產品，R4座椅已順利取得波音787客機的歐洲技術標準訂單（ETSO）認證。先前PL3530座椅已廣泛獲印度航空（Air India）與南美航空（LATAM）等多家航空公司採用。
新型R4豪華經濟艙座椅在設計上導入了整合於頭靠的隱私翼板並附設閱讀燈，旨在為乘客提供更好的隔絕感與個人隱私空間。此外，該產品配備16吋機上娛樂螢幕、具備頸部支撐功能的六向可調式頭靠、側邊環繞照明、多種電源配置介面、便利行動不便乘客使用的側邊控制台，以及具備軟啟閉機制並整合手機和平板電腦固定架的超寬餐桌。
相較於前代PL3530座椅，R4座椅擴大了座位寬度，椅距增加至約40吋，傾斜角度亦增加約2吋，同時提供小腿靠與單臂設計的腳踏板。Recaro表示，該座椅採用輕量化結構設計，有助於降低飛機總重量，進而減少碳排放並提升燃料燃燒效率。航空公司亦可針對顏色、飾條與材質進行客製化調整。
全日空計劃於2026年底前，在下一代波音787-9長程機隊上同步引進R4豪華經濟艙座椅以及R3經濟艙座椅。根據產業歷史紀錄，Recaro於2023年在漢堡舉辦的航空內飾展首度公開R4座椅概念，全日空則於2025年展會期間宣布選用該款座椅配備其豪華經濟艙。

en.title: Recaro Begins R4 Premium Economy Seat Deliveries for ANA Boeing 787-9 Fleet
en.summary: Recaro begins R4 seat deliveries with All Nippon Airways introducing the product on Boeing 787-9s in 2026.
body: Recaro Aircraft Seating has officially commenced deliveries of its new R4 premium economy seat product, with Japanese carrier All Nippon Airways (ANA) scheduled to launch the advanced seating option across its Boeing 787-9 long-haul fleet before the end of 2026.

Deliveries of the R4 seat originally began in June 2026. Marketed as the successor to Recaro's popular PL3530 long-haul premium economy seat—which is currently deployed by international air carriers including Air India and LATAM—the new R4 seating model has officially secured European Technical Standard Order (ETSO) certification for the Boeing 787 aircraft family.

The R4 premium economy seat incorporates headrest-integrated privacy wings with integrated reading lights, providing passengers with increased separation and enhanced personal privacy in the cabin. Additional passenger amenities include a 16-inch inflight entertainment screen, a six-way adjustable headrest with neck support, side ambient lighting, multiple power supply configurations, a side console offering dedicated access for passengers with reduced mobility, and an extra-wide tray table featuring a soft open-and-close mechanism and dedicated device holders.

When evaluated against its predecessor, the R4 features an expanded seat width, an increased seat pitch extending to approximately 40 inches, and an enhanced recline capability of about 2 inches. The seat is equipped with a calf rest and a single-arm footrest design. Furthermore, Recaro highlighted that the lightweight construction of the seat reduces overall aircraft weight, contributing to lower carbon emissions and improved fuel efficiency while offering customizable color and finish options.

All Nippon Airways will introduce the R4 seat alongside Recaro's R3 economy seat across its next-generation Boeing 787-9 long-haul fleet, with operational deployment scheduled to begin by late 2026. Verified industry context indicates that the R4 seating concept was initially unveiled at the Aircraft Interiors Expo 2023 in Hamburg and showcased in 2025, when All Nippon Airways formally selected the product to equip its long-haul premium economy cabins.
